purpose: Freeze one target-theory-blind behavioral substrate that preserves literal episode evidence and participant-adjudicated person-level patterns without requiring a comprehensive behavioral ontology.

authority_split.episode_fact_authority: source-grounded theory-blind extraction, with participant corrections preserved when provided
authority_split.external_reviewer_role: calibrate episode-fact fidelity and procedural integrity; do not substitute an external recurrence label for participant adjudication

notes: The semantic freeze stores locator/hash metadata, not raw source narrative in the downstream adapter projection.
The source archive is separately bound by hash and remains available for theory-blind extraction/calibration only.
An episode is a bounded reported occurrence used to ground candidate patterns.
No fixed behavioral-domain or observable membership is required.

rules: proposition must be an atomic, source-grounded statement with no latent trait or hidden-cause inference
reported_appraisal_or_belief must remain explicitly reported rather than converted into objective fact
temporal_relation requires explicit source support
absence_assessment_id is required when assertion_type is admitted_absence and forbidden otherwise
a fact does not need membership in any fixed behavioral vocabulary

derived_fields.admission_status: admitted only when awareness, opportunity, reasonable_feasibility, and established_nonoccurrence are all established; otherwise not_admitted

rules: not_admitted assessments remain audit records and do not instantiate an admitted_absence episode_fact
failure or uncertainty in an absence assessment cannot delete, weaken, recode, or demote independently supported positive episode facts
silence or missing evidence is never established_nonoccurrence
a first proposal requires at least one preproposal_anchor evidence link
proposal wording is a hypothesis/question until participant adjudication
revision_index must be monotonic inside a pattern_thread_id
previous_proposal_id must refer to the immediately prior proposal in the thread when revision_index is greater than zero
fact_ids must belong to the referenced episode
postproposal_scope_example and postproposal_counterexample records are scope/boundary evidence, not an unbiased recurrence-frequency sample
the contract defines no automatic recurrence count or count threshold
adjudications are append-only
accept requires participant_approved_wording
revise requires participant_approved_wording and must be followed by a new pattern_proposal before the thread can resolve accepted
reject and unresolved remain audit history and are not admissible resolved patterns
lack of a newly recalled postproposal example does not by itself invalidate an acceptance; it may be recorded as a retrieval discrepancy

resolved_pattern.derivation: derived from the latest valid adjudication chain for one pattern_thread_id
rules: accepted status requires a participant accept decision and at least one preproposal_anchor
no episode-count threshold can create accepted status without participant acceptance
multiple supporting episodes cannot override participant rejection
rejected and unresolved threads are retained in the research audit but omitted from the admissible downstream pattern projection
canonical serialization must deterministically produce freeze_payload_sha256
historical proposal/adjudication records are append-only and remain inspectable
a semantic correction after freeze produces a new freeze rather than mutating the old one
there is no completion denominator or implied coverage claim

open_world_policy.fact_capture: free-text atomic facts are first-class even when no existing indexing term describes them
open_world_policy.other_specified: not required as a semantic escape hatch because the core fact layer is open text
optional_index_layer: may be generated for retrieval or question generation
must be separately versioned and theory-blind
must never be required to preserve a fact
must never replace the fact proposition
may emit a vocabulary-gap record without changing semantic admissibility

participant_loop: propose candidate person-level pattern from one or more preproposal anchors
ask participant the candidate pattern question
record accept, revise, reject, or unresolved
collect nuance, scope, exceptions, and counterexamples when useful
if revised, issue a new proposal in the same thread and adjudicate again
resolve only from participant adjudication; retain full audit chain

includes: episode facts whose semantic claims are admissible under this contract
accepted resolved patterns with participant-approved wording
scope and exception information attached to accepted patterns
preproposal anchors and explicit counterexamples linked to accepted patterns
provenance identifiers, locators, and content hashes
excludes: raw transcript or raw narrative text
not_admitted absence assessments as negative evidence
rejected or unresolved proposals as substantive person-level patterns
target-specific mappings, predictions, fit information, or post-result recoding
anti_rereading_rules: downstream adapters receive only this frozen projection, never the source archive
every downstream result must bind the exact freeze_payload_sha256
if a distinction is not represented in the frozen projection, the adapter must return unmeasured/not_represented rather than reread source narrative
all downstream adapters for the same comparison consume the same freeze payload
a later substrate revision must pass through the theory-blind process and create a new freeze before any later authorized comparison

appropriate_targets: separation of observed occurrence from reported appraisal
preservation of positive facts when absence gates fail
question non-leadingness and accurate incorporation of participant corrections
freeze determinism and adapter anti-rereading enforcement
inappropriate_targets: external-coder majority vote as ground truth for whether a person-level pattern characterizes the participant
episode-count recurrence thresholds that override participant adjudication

normative_invariants: Theory-blindness is required for substantive fact extraction, semantic schema changes, and participant-pattern question generation.
Positive observed facts and genuine absence claims are separate records with separate admissibility logic.
No participant-level recurrence claim becomes accepted solely from episode counts.
No participant rejection is overridden by external episode counts.
Postproposal examples can refine scope and contradiction but are not treated as an unbiased recurrence-frequency sample.
Reported appraisal or belief remains reported appraisal or belief.
Open-world facts must remain representable without fixed categorical membership.
Raw narrative cannot be reread by downstream adapters.
No completion policy is inferred from artifact counts.
focused_semantic_test_requirements: an uncategorized positive fact survives capture, freeze, and adapter projection without an Other Specified code
dropping or changing an optional index term cannot delete or alter the underlying fact proposition
a four-part absence assessment with any gate not established cannot instantiate an admitted_absence fact
a failed or unclear absence assessment leaves all independently supported positive facts unchanged
silence or absent source evidence cannot satisfy established_nonoccurrence
reported appraisal remains distinct from an occurrence/outcome assertion
an explicit temporal relation is rejected when its source provenance does not support sequence
a pattern with one preproposal anchor can become accepted through participant adjudication without a minimum episode count
multiple supporting episodes cannot produce an accepted pattern after participant rejection
participant acceptance is not invalidated solely because no new postproposal example is recalled
postproposal examples are marked by role and cannot be consumed as automatic recurrence counts
a revise adjudication preserves the prior proposal and creates a monotonic new proposal revision
rejected and unresolved pattern threads remain auditable but are absent from the admissible downstream pattern projection
adapter projection contains no raw source text and exposes no source resolver
an adapter cannot recover an unrepresented distinction by requesting source narrative
all adapters in one comparison bind the identical freeze_payload_sha256
canonical serialization is deterministic and any semantic mutation changes the freeze hash
target-specific, prediction-derived, fit-derived, birth-derived, or chart-derived fields are rejected from the neutral substrate
the contract exposes no completion denominator and no automatic coverage claim
